changeHistory.description: Selected 44 complete source nodes from aligned male HRA v1.3 heart and vasculature. Added stable identifiers, source hashes and unreviewed status; retained source positions and glTF metre scale. Blender automatic validation removes 18 duplicate-index faces (RA 12, LM 5, SVC 1), preserving every nonduplicate oriented triangle and one original winding per duplicate-index group. Source 267360 triangles become 267342 output triangles with zero observed coordinate deviation; 835 zero-area faces remain (RA 812, LM 6, SVC 17). This documented importer exception is not anatomical repair. No anatomical reconstruction, smoothing, decimation or invented detail.
